title: 从错误中学习
passage:
Most of us were taught from an early age that mistakes are something to be avoided. In school, a wrong answer often meant a lower {{1}} and sometimes embarrassment in front of classmates. It is hardly {{2}}, then, that many students grow up fearing failure. Yet research on learning suggests that errors, when handled properly, can be among the most {{3}} tools we have.

When people make a mistake and then receive the correct answer, their brains appear to pay closer attention. The surprise of being wrong seems to {{4}} the memory of the right information, making it easier to recall later. In some experiments, students who were asked to guess answers before studying a topic actually remembered the material better than those who simply read it, even though their {{5}} guesses were mostly incorrect.

The key, however, is how mistakes are treated. If students feel {{6}} or punished, they may stop trying altogether. But if teachers present errors as a normal part of learning, students become more willing to take risks and {{7}} difficult problems. Some classrooms now hold a 'mistake of the week', inviting pupils to explain what went wrong and how they {{8}} it.

This approach is not limited to schools. Successful companies often encourage employees to share failures {{9}} so that colleagues can avoid repeating them. In the end, the goal is not to make more mistakes, but to {{10}} as much as possible from each one.
explanations: 空前有不定冠词 a 和形容词比较级 lower，需可数名词单数；答错题意味着“更低的分数”，选 grade。pressure 不可数，且“更低的压力”与语境不符。
“It is hardly + 形容词 + that...” 为形式主语句型；前文说答错会被扣分、当众出丑，所以学生害怕失败“并不令人意外”，选 surprising。
the most 与名词 tools 之间需形容词最高级成分；Yet 表转折，说明错误处理得当反而是“最有力的”学习工具，选 powerful。expensive 与褒义转折不符。
seems to 后接动词原形，宾语为 the memory；后文 “making it easier to recall later” 说明惊讶“强化”了记忆，选 strengthen。
物主代词 their 与名词 guesses 之间需形容词；学生是在学习之前先猜答案，故为“最初的”猜测，选 initial。
feel 为系动词，后接形容词，并与 punished 并列；“感到羞愧或受到惩罚”才会导致放弃尝试，选 ashamed。
and 连接两个动词原形，与 take risks 并列；“敢于冒险、攻克难题”，选 tackle。ignore 与“更愿意冒险”的语义矛盾。
与 went wrong 时态一致，需动词过去式；解释“哪里出错、如何改正”，选 corrected。delayed 语义不通。
修饰动词 share，需副词；目的是让同事避免重蹈覆辙，所以要“公开地”分享失败，选 openly。rarely 与目的状语矛盾。
to 后接动词原形，“从每个错误中尽可能多地学习”，与 as much as possible from 搭配并呼应全文主题，选 learn。

title: 减少食物浪费
passage:
Every day, large amounts of perfectly edible food end up in the rubbish bin. Some of it is lost on farms or during transport, but in wealthier societies a {{1}} share is thrown away in homes, restaurants and supermarkets. This waste is not only a moral problem in a world where many people still go hungry; it also has serious {{2}} costs. Growing, packaging and transporting food uses land, water and energy, and food that rots in landfills {{3}} greenhouse gases.

One common cause of household waste is confusion over date labels. Many shoppers believe that food becomes unsafe the moment its 'best before' date has {{4}}. In fact, this label usually refers to quality rather than safety, and many products remain perfectly good to eat for some time afterwards. Another cause is poor planning: people buy more than they need, {{5}} by special offers, and then forget what is in the fridge.

Fortunately, simple habits can make a big difference. Writing a shopping list, checking cupboards before going out and storing food {{6}} can all reduce the amount that is wasted. Leftovers can be {{7}} into new meals instead of being thrown away.

Businesses and governments also have a role to play. Some supermarkets now sell slightly damaged fruit and vegetables at lower prices, while others {{8}} unsold food to charities. A few cities collect food waste separately so that it can be turned into compost or {{9}} for buses. Such efforts show that cutting waste is not merely a personal {{10}} but a shared responsibility.
explanations: 不定冠词 a 与名词 share 之间需以辅音开头的形容词；but 强调富裕社会中有“相当大的”一部分食物在家庭和商店被浪费，选 significant。harmless 语义不通。
serious 与 costs 之间需形容词；下一句讲种植、运输耗费土地、水和能源，填埋还释放温室气体，属于“环境”代价，选 environmental。
主语 food 为第三人称单数，需动词三单形式；食物在填埋场腐烂会“释放”温室气体，选 releases。reduce 词形和语义均不符。
has 后需过去分词构成现在完成时；保质期“已过”，选 passed。
逗号间为过去分词短语作状语，与 by special offers 构成被动；人们被促销“诱惑”而多买，选 tempted。
修饰动词 storing，需副词；与列购物清单等好习惯并列，应是“妥善地”储存食物，选 properly。carelessly 与语义相反。
can be 后需过去分词构成被动，且与 into 搭配；剩菜可以“做成”新菜，transform... into 意为“把……转变成”，选 transformed。
others 为复数主语，需动词原形；超市把未售出的食物“捐给”慈善机构，donate... to，选 donate。
与 compost 并列，需名词；厨余可变成堆肥或供公交车使用的“燃料”，选 fuel。profit 与 for buses 搭配不通。
personal 后需名词，并与 a shared responsibility 形成“不仅是个人选择，更是共同责任”的对照，选 choice。

title: 城市热岛效应
topic: urban heat island, climate, public health, city planning
passage:
On a summer afternoon, the center of a large city can be several degrees warmer than the surrounding countryside. This phenomenon, known as the urban heat island, arises because concrete, asphalt and brick {{1}} heat during the day and release it slowly at night, while the {{2}} of vegetation deprives cities of the natural cooling that plants provide through evaporation. Waste heat from vehicles, factories and air conditioners further {{3}} the problem.

The consequences are far from trivial. Higher temperatures drive up demand for electricity, placing {{4}} on power grids precisely when they are most stretched. They also pose a genuine threat to public health: during heat waves, elderly residents, outdoor workers and people living in poorly ventilated housing are {{5}} vulnerable. As climate change makes extreme heat more frequent, these risks are likely to {{6}}.

Fortunately, the heat island effect is not an {{7}} feature of urban life. Trees planted along streets provide shade and cool the surrounding air, and studies in a range of cities have found that well-planned green corridors can lower local temperatures by a {{8}} margin. Reflective roofs, painted in light colors, bounce sunlight back into the sky instead of trapping it. Some cities have also begun to replace impermeable pavements with materials that allow rainwater to soak through, which helps the ground stay cooler.

Such measures, however, are rarely {{9}} evenly across a city. Wealthier districts tend to have more trees and better-insulated buildings, whereas poorer neighborhoods are often hotter and less green. Effective policy must therefore address not only the physics of heat but also its social {{10}}, ensuring that cooling strategies reach the communities that need them most.
explanations: 复数主语 concrete, asphalt and brick 后需动词原形，并与 release it 并列；白天“吸收”热量、夜间缓慢释放，选 absorb。diminish 与后文 release 矛盾。
the 与 of 之间需名词；植被“匮乏”才会使城市失去蒸发降温作用（deprives... of），选 scarcity。abundance 与语义相反。
主语 Waste heat 为单数，需动词三单形式；further 表递进，废热“加剧”了问题，选 intensifies。alleviates 意为“缓解”，与语义相反。
placing 后需名词，place strain on 为固定搭配，意为“给……带来压力”；用电需求激增时电网最吃紧，选 strain。
are 与形容词 vulnerable 之间需副词；老人、户外工作者等群体“尤其”脆弱，选 particularly。seldom 与语境相反。
be likely to 后接动词原形，且此处需不及物动词；气候变化使极端高温更频繁，风险会“升级、加剧”，选 escalate。diminish 方向相反。
冠词 an 提示空格词以元音音素开头，需形容词；Fortunately 引出热岛效应可以缓解，即它并非城市生活“不可避免的”特征，选 inevitable。
a 与 margin 之间需形容词；绿色廊道能“显著地”降低局部气温，by a considerable margin 意为“大幅度地”，选 considerable。negligible 与 Fortunately 的积极语境不符。
are rarely 后需过去分词构成被动；下文对比富裕与贫困街区绿化不均，说明这些措施很少被均匀“分布”，选 distributed。
social 后需名词，与 the physics of heat 对照；政策既要考虑热的物理层面，也要顾及其社会“层面”（谁承受负担），选 dimension。

title: 好奇心与学习
passage:
Curiosity is often treated as a charming trait of young children, something that schooling gradually {{1}} as pupils learn to sit still, follow instructions and prepare for examinations. Yet a growing body of psychological research suggests that curiosity deserves a far more {{2}} place in our understanding of learning. Far from being a mere personality quirk, it appears to {{3}} how effectively the brain takes in and retains information.

In one well-known line of laboratory studies, participants first rated how eager they were to learn the answers to various trivia questions. When tested later, they recalled the answers that had aroused their curiosity far more {{4}} than those that had not. Strikingly, they also remembered unrelated material, such as photographs of faces, that had been shown to them while they were in a curious state. Researchers have {{5}} that curiosity places the brain in a state of heightened readiness, in which reward-related circuits help strengthen the formation of memories.

These findings carry obvious {{6}} for education. If curiosity primes the mind to learn, then lessons that begin by posing an intriguing question, rather than by {{7}} a list of facts, may produce more durable understanding. Curiosity, however, has its limits. It tends to peak when people know a little about a topic and recognize a gap in their knowledge; material that is entirely {{8}} or entirely familiar rarely provokes it.

Nurturing curiosity is therefore less a matter of entertaining students than of {{9}} designing lessons that expose meaningful gaps. Teachers who welcome open-ended questions, and who admit the limits of their own knowledge, model an attitude that is rarely {{10}} by examinations alone.
explanations: 主语 schooling 为单数，需动词三单形式；“幼儿的可爱特质”暗示好奇心随着学生学会守纪律、应付考试而被逐渐“压制”，选 suppresses。
a far more 与名词 place 之间需形容词；Yet 转折后强调好奇心在学习研究中应占据“更显著的”位置，选 prominent。modest 与 Far from being a mere quirk 的语义相反。
appears to 后接动词原形，宾语为 how 引导的宾语从句；好奇心“影响”大脑吸收和记忆信息的效率，选 influence。overlook 语义不通。
修饰动词 recalled，且与 far more... than 构成比较，需副词；引起好奇的题目答案被记得“更准确”，选 accurately。
have 后需过去分词构成现在完成时，并能接 that 从句；研究者对机制进行“推测”，选 speculated。denied 与上下文的支持性论述相反。
obvious 后需名词，carry implications for 为常见搭配，意为“对……有启示/影响”，选 implications。obstacles 不与 carry... for education 搭配。
介词 by 后接动名词，与 by posing 并列对照；“以抛出问题开头，而不是直接罗列事实”，选 presenting。
entirely 与 or entirely familiar 并列，需形容词，且与 familiar 意义相对；完全“无法理解”或完全熟悉的材料都难以激发好奇，选 incomprehensible。
介词 of 与动名词 designing 之间需副词修饰；与“取悦学生”相对，是“有意识地”设计能暴露知识缺口的课程，选 deliberately。
is rarely 后需过去分词构成被动；这种求知态度很少仅靠考试就能“培养”出来，与段首 Nurturing 呼应，选 cultivated。
